# Hedge 3
Lets a chip holder reshape potted plants.
## Using it - Get the chip implanted at a [color=#a4885c]skillchip station[/color]. - Hold a sharp item. - Click a potted plant and stand still for a moment while you trim it.
Cosmetic. Without the chip the same click stashes the item inside the plant as usual.
## Notes - The new shape is random. - Moving cancels the trim.
